Overview

RTV Implementation
Web Platform

The Implementation web platform is the office-facing complement to the mobile app. Built in React and TypeScript, it provides comprehensive dashboards, detailed programme analytics, data management, and administrative control for Project Officers, Project Managers, and Administrators.

What the Web Platform Does

Programme Analytics
Live dashboards across all modules — Agriculture, VSLA, VSF, Livestock, Check-ins, Trainings, and Workplans.
VSF Approval
Officer review and Manager approval of Village Savings Fund loan applications.
Leadership Management
Register and manage all eight champion types across villages and clusters.
Workplan Tracking
District and national-level workplan creation, progress monitoring, and performance tracking.
WorkMate AI
AI assistant trained on programme data for instant field team support.
User Administration
Create, edit, and manage accounts across all roles. Assign districts and clusters.
Data Export
Export reports as CSV or Excel across all modules for offline analysis.
Settings
Programme configuration, financial thresholds, and system-wide parameters.

Tech Stack

Framework
React 18 with TypeScript — component-based architecture with strict type safety.
State Management
Redux Toolkit with RTK Query — server state managed via auto-generated API hooks with caching and optimistic updates.
UI Components
Ant Design component library styled with SASS theme overrides using RTV brand tokens.
Charts
ApexCharts for all analytical visualisations — bar, line, pie, donut, and area charts.
Routing
React Router with role-based route guards — pages are protected at the component level based on the authenticated user's role.
Getting Started

Authentication

Access the web platform through your organisation's designated URL. Authentication is role-based — the platform loads a different layout and module set depending on your assigned role.

Logging In

1
Open the platform URL
Use a modern browser (Chrome, Edge, or Firefox recommended).
2
Choose your login method
Select Login with Email or Login with Phone Number. Enter your credentials and click Sign In.
3
Role-based redirect
The platform redirects you to your role's default landing page. Sidebar and modules reflect your permissions.
—
Session persistence
The session remains active for an extended period. If it expires, you are redirected to the login page automatically.

Password Reset

Click Forgot Password on the login screen. Enter your email address — a reset link is sent to that address.

Getting Started

Navigation

The platform uses a persistent left sidebar for primary navigation, a top header for global actions, and breadcrumbs within each module for sub-navigation.

Top Header Controls

Notifications bell
Shows pending items — new VSF applications, workplan deadlines, and system alerts.
Profiles filter
Scopes all dashboard data to a specific District, Cluster, and Village. Changes apply platform-wide until cleared.
User avatar / menu
Access your profile, language settings, and logout from the top-right dropdown.

Common Table Controls

  • Search bar: Full-text search across visible columns.
  • Column sort: Click any column header to sort ascending; click again for descending.
  • Date range filter: Select start and end dates to narrow records.
  • District / Cluster filter: Dropdown selectors filter records to a geographic area.
  • Export: Exports the currently filtered data set as CSV or Excel.
  • Pagination: 10, 25, or 50 records per page.
Getting Started

Roles & Permissions

Three roles access the web platform. A fourth role — Champion — uses only the mobile app for VSF and VSLA tasks.

Admin
Unrestricted access across all modules, all districts, and all administrative functions. Can manage user accounts, configure settings, approve any submission, and export all data.
Project Manager
Full access to assigned districts. Manages VSF final approvals, views district analytics, oversees workplans, and monitors team performance. Cannot create or modify user accounts.
Project Officer
Access to assigned district data. Reviews and forwards VSF applications, monitors field team submissions, manages workplans, and accesses training and check-in reports.
—
Data scope
All roles see only data within their assigned geography. Admins see all data.

Module

Community Cards

Tracks RTV Community Card distributions and their activation status across all villages. Gives Officers and Managers visibility into card issuance progress and helps identify households still needing cards.

—
Available to
Project OfficerManagerAdmin

Active vs. Inactive

The Active tab lists all households with a live Community Card. Filter by district, cluster, or village to check issuance progress in a specific area. The Inactive tab shows cards with status Damaged, Lost, Temporary, or Replacement Pending — use this to prioritise replacement issuance and keep QR attendance tracking complete.

AI Tools

WorkMate AI

An AI assistant built into the platform, trained on programme data, field guides, and RTV knowledge resources. Ask questions in plain language and receive contextual, accurate answers.

—
Available to
Project AssistantProject OfficerManagerAdmin
1
Open WorkMate
Click WorkMate in the sidebar. A chat interface opens, accessible from any page in the platform.
2
Type your question
Ask in plain language — e.g. "What is the minimum latrine standard for compliance?" or "How many VSLA groups are in Kirehe this month?"
3
Review and follow up
WorkMate returns a structured answer with source references. Ask follow-up questions in the same thread — context is maintained for the session.
—
Best results
Ask specific questions. "What are the compost maturity criteria for the agriculture check-in?" returns a more useful answer than "Tell me about agriculture."
Administration

User Management

Administrator-only function for creating accounts, setting roles, assigning geographic areas, and deactivating users.

—
Available to
Admin only
1
Navigate to Settings > User Management and click Add User
2
Enter full name, email, phone number, and role
3
Assign geographic scope
Select the districts this user can access. For Officers and PAs, also assign specific clusters.
4
Click Create Account
The system sends a welcome email with a temporary password — the user must change it on first login.
—
Role changes take effect immediately
Downgrading a role removes access on both the web platform and mobile app. Data created under the previous role is preserved.
Administration

Platform-wide configuration managed by Administrators, including geographic hierarchy, household profiles, system parameters, and support resources.

—
Available to
Admin only — some read-only views available to Managers
Administrative Units
Geographic hierarchy management — Regions, Districts, Clusters, and Villages. Changes propagate to all form dropdowns and dashboard filters.
Households
The central household registry. Manage status, update household head details, and view programme participation history.
Programme Configuration
Programme cycle dates, compliance score weights, and champion allocation thresholds.
VSF Financial Thresholds
Maximum loan amounts, growth fee range, repayment period limits, and late payment escalation days.
Audit Log
Read-only log of all administrative actions with timestamps, actor, and before/after values.
Reference

Reports & Data Export

Every major data view on the platform supports export. Always apply filters before exporting to avoid downloading the full dataset.

Excel (.xlsx)
Default format — column headers, formatted data, conditional formatting on status fields. Use for analysis in Excel or Google Sheets.
CSV (.csv)
Plain comma-delimited. Use for statistical software (R, STATA, SPSS) or data warehouses.
—
Large exports
Exports above 10,000 rows are processed asynchronously — you receive an email with a download link when the file is ready.
